measurement: Playwright pointermove capture timestamp to live preview style mutation while the tilt pointer remained down; the same crop frame is a child of the transformed preview and its bounds moved before release.
acceptance: All three observed updates occurred before the 120 ms raster-preview debounce and before pointer release.
rasterWork: The focused component test verified no createStudentScanPreview call during a held tilt gesture, including after 130 ms; one new raster preview was requested after release.
limitations: These are one browser-emulation sample per project, not frame-rate statistics or a physical-phone measurement. The owner will assess tactile smoothness on their device.
